item.title: Aptoide becomes the first rival app store to return to Google Play in the US
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Aptoide has brought its games store back to Google Play after more than a decade, as court-ordered changes open Android to competing app stores.

item.title: Social media platforms still facing thousands of user addiction lawsuits after failed appeals
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Platforms like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Google are facing a long road of litigation.

item.title: YouTube now requires creators to have twice as many watch hours to start earning money
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Creators who want to start earning on the platform will need at least 8,000 qualified watch hours over the past year or 20 million qualified Shorts views in the last 90 days.

item.title: Clicks’ Power Keyboard brings BlackBerry-style typing to any phone — with some compromises
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Clicks’ $99 Power Keyboard brings a customizable, slide-out physical keyboard to MagSafe and Qi2 smartphones, but its added heft can make larger phones awkward to use

item.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Meta’s new open-weight Muse Glimmer model offers a glimpse of Mark Zuckerberg’s personal superintelligence vision, as well as the emerging divide between AI users can own and access.

item.title: Sila lands $1.4B Pentagon loan as militaries demand more batteries
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Battery materials startup Sila will use a $1.4 billion loan from the U.S. Department of Defense to scale production at its factory in Washington state.

item.title: Archer buys former rival Wisk Aero
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The two companies were once embroiled in a trade secret theft lawsuit. Now, Wisk is being absorbed into Archer.

item.title: A data breach at shipping giant Ceva Logistics is rippling across banks, retailers, Steam gamers, and beyond
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Companies that rely on Ceva Logistics for shipping their physical goods to customers say their personal data was taken during a recent cyberattack.

item.title: Signed up for Klaviyo? Dozens of advertisers may have seen your password
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: A bug in the tech giant's website the logo of US marketing automation company Klaviyo Inc. is seen displayed on a smartphone in front of an abstract background on a computer screen..

item.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Discovered Materials raised $9 million to fund the hunt for more novel materials to build more efficient chips.

item.title: Google Play adds Venmo as a payment option
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The ability to add Venmo to Google Play comes as people are spending more money on apps and games.

item.title: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: The AI-focused hedge fund is still making some big bets.

item.title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: Programming with Claude Code will soon require even less human oversight.

item.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Zoox prepares for launch and Uber’s AV empire
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.

item.title: Historian Jill Lepore says Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: On the latest episode of Equity, we spoke to Jill Lepore about "government by machines" and why Elon Musk is a bad science fiction reader.

item.title: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: AI agents are escaping cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real-world systems, raising questions about whether safety infrastructure, industry standards, and regulation can keep pace with increasingly powerful models.

item.title: This ‘adversarial’ pattern can prevent surveillance cameras from detecting you
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: A security researcher has designed an algorithm that can create computer-generated patterns capable of hiding people, faces, and vehicles from detection by surveillance cameras.

item.title: This former notorious red-light district is now one of the world’s top AI hubs
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: More than 20 years ago, King's Cross was one of the seediest area's in London. Now it's sprouting something new.

item.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the US
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: AI has already had a significant impact on Amazon’s carbon emissions, which it reported were up 16% last year — the wrong direction for a company that pledged to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040.

item.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: Founder Ahmed Beshry describes the startup’s product as one “that could turn prompts, notes, documents, or research into a polished, editable presentation.”
